req.title: Index renders even with zero posts
req.statement: The system shall render the index page with 'No posts' or empty state when the post table is empty.
triggers: index renders even with zero posts

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the index page should render correctly even when there are no posts in the database. This involves ensuring that the system handles an empty state gracefully and returns the appropriate HTTP status code. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct rendering with no posts, a negative test to check for client errors, and a boundary test to ensure correct behavior when transitioning from one post to zero posts.

tests.name: test_index_renders_with_no_posts
preconditions: Database is initialized with no posts.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'No posts' in r.data

tests.name: test_index_renders_with_invalid_method
actions: Attempt to POST to the index page.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
try:
    r = client.post('/')
    assert r.status_code == 405
except AssertionError:
    print('Expected HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed')

tests.name: test_index_renders_boundary_one_post
preconditions: Database is initialized with one post.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (id, author_id, created, title, body) VALUES (21, 1, '2025-04-02 10:30:37', 'Single Post', 'This is a single post.')")
    db.commit()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Single Post' in r.data
